gifts.message: No matter how many miles separate us or how busy life gets, you will always be the first person I turn to when I need a laugh, an honest opinion, or someone to split the last slice of pizza. Thank you for always protecting me, cheering for my craziest dreams, and never letting me forget where we came from. Happy Raksha Bandhan! ❤️
gifts.surpriseMessage: I booked our tickets for that concert we've been wanting to attend since 2019! Check your email this weekend. Here's to making 100 more memories together.

giftReasons.title: Always Having My Back
giftReasons.text: Even when I made the worst mistakes, you never judged — you just helped me fix them.

giftReasons.title: Our Secret Language of Looks
giftReasons.text: We can communicate an entire paragraph across a crowded family dinner with one eyebrow raise.

giftReasons.title: The Best Playlist Curator
giftReasons.text: Every great road trip song I love today is because you played it in the car first.

giftReasons.title: Unmatched Loyalty
giftReasons.text: You'll roast me for an hour straight, but defend me fiercely against anyone else.
